# Mittal Plastic Works

> Precision Plastic Injection Moulding Manufacturer in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity:** Mittal Plastic Works (MPW)
- **Founder & Managing Director:** Mr. Vineet Kumar (Vineet Mittal)
- **Year of Establishment:** 2004 (20+ years of manufacturing experience)
- **Location:** 509, Baghpat Rd, Sabun Godam, Chanderlok, Meerut, Uttar Pradesh 250002, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91-9837075324
- **Email:** mplasticw@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://mittalplasticworks.com
- **Primary Industry:** Plastic Injection Moulding, Industrial Polymer Manufacturing, Sports Goods Packaging Components

## Product Catalog & Technical Specifications

### 1. 45mm Plastic Core
- **Outer Diameter:** 45.0 mm (± 0.05 mm tolerance)
- **Material:** Virgin Grade Polypropylene (PP)
- **Applications:** Shuttlecock packaging tubes, industrial roll winding, protective cylindrical packaging
- **Features:** High radial hoop strength, crush-resistant wall thickness, zero parting line flash

### 2. 6mm Plastic Core
- **Outer Diameter:** 6.0 mm (± 0.03 mm tolerance)
- **Material:** Engineering Polymer (PP / Nylon)
- **Applications:** Precision winding, sports goods components, mechanical fittings
- **Features:** High concentricity, non-warping, precision core pins

### 3. 45mm Core + Jalli Assembly
- **Configuration:** 45mm cylindrical core pre-assembled with ventilated lattice mesh (jalli)
- **Material:** High-Impact Virgin PP
- **Applications:** Sports goods cylinder packaging (shuttlecock boxes), protective airflow containers
- **Features:** Snug snap-fit, impact resistant, smooth outer finish

### 4. 65mm Core + Jalli Assembly
- **Configuration:** 65mm large-diameter cylindrical core with integrated lattice grid
- **Material:** Heavy-Gauge Polypropylene (PP)
- **Applications:** Heavy-duty sports packaging, industrial component containment
- **Features:** Reinforced base ribs, uniform wall thickness, high crush tolerance

### 5. Plastic Jalli (Mesh Component)
- **Design:** Radial lattice grid / airflow mesh component
- **Material:** Polypropylene (PP) / Polyethylene (PE)
- **Applications:** Protective end-caps, airflow ventilation, protective barriers
- **Features:** Clean molded apertures, burr-free edges, uniform shrinkage

### 6. Custom Injection Tooling & Mould Development
- **Capabilities:** CAD/CAM design analysis, hardened P20 / H13 steel dies, multi-cavity tooling
- **Materials Processed:** Polypropylene (PP), High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE), Low-Density Polyethylene (LDPE), Polyamide (Nylon)
- **Production Capacity:** 10M+ components annually with multi-shift operations and 100% generator power backup

## B2B Ordering & Logistics
- **Minimum Order Quantities (MOQ):** Flexible trial batches for new buyers; scheduled monthly contracts of 10,000 to 200,000+ units for established clients
- **Lead Times:** Stock standard products dispatch within 24 to 48 hours; custom die runs dispatch within 5 to 7 days
- **Sample Policy:** Physical component samples provided for dimensional fitment and stress testing prior to bulk production
- **Shipping Coverage:** Pan-India freight dispatch connecting Delhi-NCR, Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, and nationwide logistics hubs
- **Quotations:** Submit online RFQ at https://mittalplasticworks.com/contacts.html or direct factory WhatsApp at https://wa.me/919837075324
